pr.title: Spec an I don't understand action for every inbox item
pr.head: 75a6ee2d85cd4b8e575d9e56475e8c56cf753266

summary: Projector's inbox holds the questions, notices, and requests that agents post for you. Projector's panel, above the Claude Code prompt, lists them, and each item's drawer shows its detail and the actions you can take, each on a digit key. When an item is written in the agent's shorthand, the only way to say you don't follow is discuss, which makes you type a sentence. For a notice, even that fails: a notice cannot be revised, and a reply to a subagent's notice never reaches that subagent.

This pull request adds a plan, inbox/unclear, at status ready and priority now. It specifies an I don't understand action on 6 in every open item's drawer. One press runs a new person-only command, project inbox unclear, which records unclear on the item. The panel then delivers UNCLEAR <number> <subject> to the posting agent, by the same claim-and-settle path that STARTED uses, and the agent revises the item in place. Notices become revisable. A question's other answers and a request's options are both capped at four, so 6 stays free even when a request has Start on 1. No code changes in this pull request.

The plan was first written before #379, which lets a request carry options of its own. This head merges main and revises the plan for it: it caps request options too, gives stored items that use 6 a digitless action, and bumps the agents block to version 23, since #379 took 22. It also guards the action against a stale drawer, as start is guarded. No review finding is open.

cards.title: Terms
cards.html:
• Drawer: the panel area that opens under an inbox item, with its detail, choices, and actions.
  • Line owed: a message such as ANSWER, DISMISSED, or STARTED that the store records as waiting for delivery to the posting agent.
  • Claim: a deliverer's lease on the line an item owes, so that only one deliverer sends it.
  • Agents block: the versioned instructions that project init writes into a repository's AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md.

groups.title: The I don't understand plan
groups.kicker: A new nested plan under the completed inbox project
intro: The plan is the only file. Its sections follow the repository's plan layout: the problem, the solution with its flow, store, CLI, tools, and files, the reasons for the design, acceptance criteria, cost, rollout, and open questions.
Read it against main. Main includes #379, which changed how a request's drawer numbers its options and took agents block version 22.

checks.text: project show inbox/unclear --json and project check accept the plan at this head, its frontmatter matches what project create writes, and the parent inbox and inbox/requests plans are unchanged.
The only open question, the look of the action and its mark, has an owner and is deferred, so it does not block the ready status.

files.note: The whole plan: an I don't understand action on 6 that sends UNCLEAR to the posting agent and makes notices revisable.

checks.text: On main, revise refuses a notice with "withdraw it and tell again", and claim refuses every notice, as this section and § 2.3 say.

On main, a request with a start action and five options shows its fifth option on 6, and check_request_options reads the shared MAX_OPTIONS. So the cap of four that this section adds keeps 6 free, and § 2.1 gives an item stored with a choice on 6 a digitless action.
owed_line, claimed_line, claim, settle, and clear_for_outcome exist on main, and a claimed STARTED keeps its claim through an outcome, which is the behavior this section extends to unclear.
The --subject and --detail guard mirrors start --action. On main, act closes the drawer only on exit 0 and reads the store again on exit 65, so a refused press leaves the drawer open on the new text.
Main's agents block is at version 22, which #379 shipped, so 23 is the next free version.
